# Artemis Leonardou

> Full stack engineer, DevRel Lead, public speaker, and tech content creator based in Athens. Building products, speaking about AI agents in production, and teaching people to build with AI.

Artemis Leonardou (known online as Artemis Codes, @artemis.codes) is a 19-year-old engineer, public speaker, and content creator. She is a Software Engineer and DevRel Lead at NOFire AI, a UGC Creator at Lovable, and an Informatics student at NKUA (Top 1%). Her main Instagram (@artemis.codes) has 300k+ monthly views and 6.7k followers, growing rapidly.

## What she does

- **Builds**: Full stack web applications, AI-integrated products, mobile apps (Python/Django, Next.js, React Native)
- **Speaks**: Conference talks and workshops on AI agents in production, AI-assisted development, and Gen Z builder culture
- **Creates**: Short-form tech content on TikTok and Instagram covering AI tools, vibe coding, and practical AI builder tutorials
- **DevRel**: Developer Relations Lead at NOFire AI, building the Context and Control Model for production
